messages:
maria: Quick follow-up from the metering RFC — we observed a class of orphaned tokens when requests are chunked/streamed and the final accounting event never carries the original handshake provenance. Thinking of a tiny "token-proof" sidecar written at handshake time that downstream stages can join on. Minimal fields: req_id, tenant_id, prefix_fingerprint. open to alternatives.

sam: Can you sketch the write path? worried about adding sync work on the hot path.

maria: plan is to piggyback on the existing handshake ack path. write to the same write-ahead topic but a separate compacted stream (sidecar-topic) so it's cheap to lookup. write is async but with at-least-once semantics; we add a TTL to avoid unbounded retention. p95 write impact expected <1ms (we measured on staging).

kyle: if sidecar arrives after billing events, how do we avoid losing attribution? do we need a reconciliation/fill path?

maria: good point. two fallbacks: 1) realtime join if sidecar present before event; 2) deferred replay reconciler that matches events to late sidecars within an N-hour window and patches missing attribution (emits audit events).

jess: from product/audit side — auditors want deterministic proofs for the billing window. late-attribution is ok so long as we emit explicit repair events and flag downstream invoices as provisional until reconciliation completes. can we add an audit marker? :thinking_face:

maria: yes — reconcile patches produce a "provenance-repair" audit event that includes original event id, claimed attribution, and confidence (exact | best-effort). That lets billing mark adjustments.

sam: what does the sidecar payload look like? small example pls.

maria: code: ```json
{
  "req_id": "r_01F...",
  "tenant_id": "t-123",
  "prefix_fp": "sha1:abcd1234",
  "handshake_ts": 1699999999,
  "schema_v": "v1"
}
```

kyle: prefix_fp is compact but collisions? we'll need collision-resistant scheme for 1e9 tokens. sha256 prefix 64-bit? also adds compute cost on client.

maria: we can use siphash64 keyed per-tenant + a short sha256 prefix for cross-tenant uniqueness. tradeoff: slightly larger sidecar, much cheaper to store and index.

sam: storage/ops concerns: separate compacted topic per-region? or multi-tenant single topic with tenant sharding?

maria: single topic partitioned by tenant hash is fine for operations. retention policy: compact + TTL 7d (configurable). reconciler will only consider late sidecars within TTL.

jess: audit retention needs 90 days for compliance. are repair audit events different from sidecar retention?

maria: yes — sidecar is retention for join; audit/repair events are full events stored in the audit log (longer retention) so we keep an immutable trail for compliance. sidecar TTL is short; audit trail retains everything for 90+ days.

sam: how will consumers join? by exact req_id match or by prefix_fp keyed lookup?

maria: prefer req_id where available. for chunked flows that don't propagate req_id, consumers will fallback to prefix_fp matching. join ranking: req_id exact -> tenant+prefix exact -> best-effort time-window match.

kyle: dedupe/at-least-once semantics: if sidecar is produced multiple times we must ensure reconciler and accounting are idempotent. suggest canonicalize sidecar by req_id and write-if-not-exists via compacted topic keying.

maria: agreed. sidecar key = req_id if present else prefix_fp + handshake_ts_bucket. writes are upserts to compacted topic so duplicate writes are fine.

ingest-bot: metering-sidecar prototype deployed to staging: metering-sidecar:v0.1 -> staging (2024-11-05T03:12:00Z) :rocket:

sam: can we add a microbenchmark for write latency and topic throughput? put results in the RFC follow-up doc.

maria: yes — I'll add benchmarks and a cost estimate (storage + egress) to the PR. initial estimate: ~0.2 bytes/token overhead on average, plus small per-handshake entry.

jess: product ok with provisional invoices + repair audit flow, want a dashboard flagging >0.5% late-attribution rate per-tenant.

maria: noted — will add telemetry: per-tenant late-attribution rate, reconcile success rate, and repair volume. alerting threshold 0.5% by default.

sam: operational runbook? if sidecar topic falls behind, how do we avoid invoice drift?

\kmaria: runbook: set consumer lag SLOs, alerted at >5s p95 lag, emergency fallback is to mark invoices provisional and pause finalization until reconciler runs.

maria: decision summary: 1) implement compacted sidecar topic with small envelope (req_id, tenant_id, prefix_fp, ts, schema_v). 2) async write on handshake, upsert semantics for idempotency. 3) TTL 7d for join usability, audit/repair events retained 90d. 4) reconciliation job to patch late attribution and emit provenance-repair audit events. 5) telemetry and alerting for late-attribution >0.5%. I'll open the PR and link bench results. :thumbsup:
